records.note: 'More evidence and novel treatments ... they're coming': 'more' is a quantifier with no countable set, 'novel treatments' names no drug, device, trial or milestone (start, readout, approval), and 'coming' is not a deadline. The development claim about long-acting clonidine belongs to the quoted 2013 review, endorsed but with no event of its own. Rerun of a 2023 piece; 'in 2023' dates the author's view, not an outcome.

Same sentence as owen-1519 ('We need more evidence and novel treatments, and as you can see above, they're coming') captured twice in the same post; the first row stands. Read on its own it would be VAGUE: the finder's entities (TMS, Monarch eTNS, MindMed) are the context's examples, and the quote names no milestone or date for any of them.

event.asset: Anti-kickback statute safe-harbor protection for rebates paid by drug manufacturers to pharmacy benefit managers
event.entity: US Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General (anti-kickback statute safe harbors)
event.title: Anti-kickback safe harbor for PBM rebates removed
event.proposition: The federal government removes anti-kickback statute safe-harbor protection for rebates paid by prescription drug manufacturers to pharmacy benefit managers.
event.criterion: TRUE on the Federal Register publication date of a final rule by the HHS Office of Inspector General, or the signing date of an enacted federal law, that removes anti-kickback statute safe-harbor protection for rebates paid by prescription drug manufacturers to pharmacy benefit managers or to the health plans they serve, or that brings such a removal into effect. A proposed rule, a request for information, an executive order that only directs rulemaking, a report, and any action that delays a removal do not count.

resolution_source.name: Federal Register (HHS-OIG final rules); enacted federal law as published by Congress

readings: 'The safe harbor that makes this otherwise completely illegal activity completely legal' is read, from the post's context on the FTC report on PBM rebates and markups, as the anti-kickback statute safe harbor that protects manufacturer rebates to PBMs.
'Someone' in 'an incoming administration' is read as the federal executive: HHS-OIG, which writes the safe harbors, acting by final rule, or the President signing a federal law with the same effect.
'Yank' is read as removal of protection for PBM rebates; a narrowing that still protects PBM rebates does not count.

records.phrase: someone might decide to yank the safe harbor
records.stage_note: At the statement date the safe harbor is in force: the post reacts to an FTC report on PBM markups, and the author frames removal as something an incoming administration hostile to PBMs 'might' do. No base-rate class in the table covers rescission of a federal safe harbor.
records.note: Hedged expectation in rhetorical-question form: 'might' is the strongest phrase in the claim sentence and sets bin C (as owen-1269). The 'if I was in an incoming administration' frame is a hypothetical about the author, not an observable condition, so no condition is set; 'I don't know. It's not up to me' confirms that a third party decides. 'Incoming administration' is not a deadline: undated, 24-month window from 2025-01-16. Not affiliated: no disclosed role at HHS or any PBM.

Counterfactual about a PBM executive's comfort 'today' versus 'the prior day'. No observable event can be written: the author names no action (referral, charge, hearing, resignation), body or date, and 'less comfortable' is a state of mind. Read as forward-looking it still has no event or threshold.

The author's own correction article 'working its way into the journal'. A publication of the forecaster's own work is a commitment, not a forecast (as owen-1243); the journal is also unnamed and no date is given.

Whether Andrew Wakefield gets 'another academic gig' is an individual's employment prospect, not a regulatory, trial, company, payer or practice-adoption outcome. 'Hard' also has no threshold and there is no date.
General claim about detection of academic fraud and fraudsters' careers. Not one of the five areas; 'most academic fraud' has no countable set and 'never' is not a deadline.
Speculation that Andrew Wakefield's influence could contribute to Elle Macpherson's eventual death: a public figure's personal health outcome, outside the five areas. 'Eventual' is not a deadline.

TikTok's return after the US divest-or-ban law is a technology and political matter, outside the five areas (as the Trump legal items in code-20 and the election items in code-29). The packet's own context for owen-1529 also records that the app came back online the same day, so the outcome was determined on the statement date.
The commercial fate of the author's own poem. Outside the five areas (as owen-0847 on his poetry contest entries); 'a commercial hit' also has no threshold or series.

Trump acting on TikTok 'with some dubious legal basis': a political and legal action about a social-media app, outside the five areas. 'Do something' names no action and 'dubious legal basis' is a judgment with no resolution source.
Users posting celebratory TikTok videos: social-media behaviour, outside the five areas; no countable set or date.
Future historical judgment of the TikTok law and its undoing. Outside the five areas; 'go down in the annals' has no resolution source, threshold or date.
Realization of Martin Luther King's dream 'will take longer': a societal and political claim outside the five areas; 'longer' has no benchmark and no date.
Rhetorical generalization that white privilege will 'eventually' turn on those who oppose it. A social-system claim outside the five areas; 'eventually' is not a deadline and no event is named.
Moral aphorism ('judged by the content of our character') with an explicitly unknown time. Outside the five areas; no observable event.

Relays an unconfirmed 'UHC insider' tip that UnitedHealth Group is running another reduction in force, and says so ('we will see if this piece of information pans out'). Passes on sourced information about another organization's internal action (layoffs), as owen-0994 and owen-1001; not scored.

Statement of uncertainty about the timescale of UnitedHealthcare's prior-authorization reduction ('It could take... Any amount of time'). No event, metric, threshold or date can be written; 'the immediacy of the relief' has no measure.

Claim that Google News alerts will deliver every future UnitedHealthcare article of the author's own newsletter. The newsletter's own distribution is outside the five areas (as owen-1363), and 'everybody who's got a Google news alert' has no resolution source.
Ironic aside that the inauguration 'may impact public markets'. No direction, threshold, index or series; 'impact' is not an observable event. Read sincerely it still cannot be written.
Living under threat of political violence 'gonna be true for a lot of people soon'. Outside the five areas; 'a lot of people' has no countable set and 'soon' is not a deadline.
Whether the author himself receives death threats: a personal, self-referential outcome outside the five areas, with no resolution source.

Macbeth parody verse ('a tale Told by an idiot ... Reforming nothing') on Ramaswamy's exit from DOGE. Marked parody, not the forecaster's plain-voice expectation. Read sincerely, 'reforming nothing' names no rule, count or benchmark and would be VAGUE.
Well-wish presupposing a Ramaswamy run for public office in Ohio. Electoral politics are outside the five areas (as the election items in code-29); there is also no prediction verb and no date.

'Hot opportunity for investors in health tech' is a promotional slogan: no buyer, transaction, valuation benchmark or series can be written, and Theranos is defunct, so 'what they actually built' has no owner or vehicle. Republished essay; the same claim as owen-0230.

'This' (fake-it-till-you-make-it near-fraud) 'will continue till we demand otherwise': a behaviour of an undefined class of companies with no countable set, series, threshold or date; the horizon is open-ended and conditional on an unwritten public demand. Republished essay.
Same sentence as owen-1551 ('And it will continue till we demand otherwise') captured twice in the same post; the first row stands. On its own it would be VAGUE for the same reasons.

A new plague (H5N1, Marburg or another) dragging society back to a 'primeval state': a pandemic and social-breakdown claim outside the five areas. Also a rhetorical question with no event, threshold or date.

Doubt that a mortality difference 'would' appear 'absent a much larger data set'. No named trial, publication, series or threshold: which study, which comparison and which sample size would count are not given. The condition (data-set size) is also unwritten.

Possibility that the meta-analysis psychotherapies 'could' be delivered in hospitals and 'might be effective'. No named program, trial, adoption metric or date; a capability and a hypothesis, not a writable event.

'They' (insurance companies) 'may not want to pay for care that doesn't work'. No payer, policy, treatment code or date; 'care that doesn't work' has no definition. The closing clause is a preference.

'We should be profoundly ashamed ... and we should diligently work to do so': normative. The one predictive clause, 'This also will take funding', is a truism with no funder, amount, program or date, so no predictive event can be written.

Restates the meta-analysis finding as a conditional capability ('if we do both of those things, we can reduce the rate of suicide attempts'). No future state is asserted; no program, series, threshold or date.
New neuromodulation data are 'able to change practice rapidly': no named practice, guideline, adoption series or threshold, and 'rapidly' is not a deadline. Present-tense general claim.

'With transcranial magnetic stimulation, we might have a new effective treatment toolkit' for anorexia nervosa. Which milestone would count (a named trial result, an FDA clearance, guideline adoption) is not given, so the event cannot be written without invention; no date. The author's clinics deliver TMS, but the primary failure is the missing event.
Present-tense appraisal ('rTMS seems like a promising option'). No future state, event or date is asserted.

'Denied by most payors' is a quantifier with no countable set (which payers, which policy documents), and denial of an unlabeled indication restates the status quo. The second clause is a counterfactual ('even if there were' a label) with no payer, policy or date. 'Much like parachutes' is sarcasm; the sincere reading still cannot be written.
Announcement that the author's own podcast appearance is part one of two. Own-content release (as owen-0045 and owen-0226); also outside the five areas.

Aphorism that about half of medical-school learning will later prove wrong. Knowledge turnover in medical education is outside the five areas; 'what you learn' has no countable set and 'later' is not a deadline. Rerun of an older post.
General expectation that private equity 'is going to' buy the future doctor's clinic 'later'. No acquirer, target, countable set, series or date (as owen-0274). Rerun of an older post.
